name: Can Frasheski Construction help with custom cabinets for rooms other than kitchens?
description: Yes, Frasheski Construction provides custom cabinets for any room, including bathrooms, home offices, and living areas.

mainEntity.name: Can Frasheski Construction help with custom cabinets for rooms other than kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. While kitchens are a popular application, custom-fit cabinet solutions are ideal for any room in your home. We design and build custom cabinetry for bathrooms (vanities, linen closets), home offices (built-in desks, shelving), living rooms (entertainment centers, bookshelves), and mudrooms or entryways (storage benches, cubbies). Our goal is to create functional and beautiful storage solutions tailored to any space in your Berkeley or East Bay home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Frasheski Construction provides custom cabinets for any room, including bathrooms, home offices, and living areas.
